query: WITH ranked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sort_order,id)-1)::int AS new_order FROM photos WHERE album_id=$2 AND deleted_at IS NULL), desired AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM unnest($1::uuid[],ARRAY(SELECT new_order FROM ranked WHERE id=ANY($1) ORDER BY new_order)) AS m(id,new_order)) UPDATE photos p SET sort_order=coalesce(d.new_order,r.new_order) FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN desired d ON d.id=r.id WHERE p.id=r.id AND p.sort_order IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(d.new_order,r.new_order)
